basis.visualNote: User rejects new detailed engravings and complicated priest features; follow the already selected minimal family

ratings.originalReplacements: New artwork must use a new candidate/asset ID and must be reviewed independently; never resurrect a <3 original

design.intent: functional liturgical pictogram, not an engraved religious scene
design.sceneTreatment: Keep only the shapes required to identify actor, action and necessary object; scenery should never compete with posture
design.priestFace: In rear views no face rendered; in side/front views use basic head oval or silhouette, no eyes, eyebrows, eyelashes, nose modelling, mouth modelling or portrait likeness; only mouth-chalice contact outline if essential
design.hair: single outer contour or one restrained mass; no individual strands, highlights, hairline engraving or gradients
design.vestments: one clean alb silhouette, simple chasuble outline, at most the existing master's minimal cross/band motif; no brocade patterns, detailed lace, embroidery, decorative edging, or many folds
design.armsHands: Gesture is dominant; anatomical placement exact but fingers simplified to groups, with thumb-index separate only when the rubric hinges on it; clear wrists, no extra limbs
design.altar: single shared minimal altar base derived from verified accepted composition: basic table/cloth line, crucifix and candlesticks only where context required; no architectural panels, floral patterns, carved arches, cloth lace, ornament or shrine-like scenery
design.minister: simple distinct dalmatic/surplice silhouette and clear actor position, never a second detailed portrait
design.objects: draw only the sacred object needed to differentiate the action (Host, chalice, paten, thurible, pall, Missal); never add ceremonial props to fill space
design.incense: one restrained thurible shape; at most 1–2 thin smoke strokes if needed for recognition; no billowing smoke cloud
design.lineLanguage: monochrome filled silhouette with sparse clear cut-outs, no crosshatching, etching, texture, halftone, gradients, shading or photorealism
design.composition: one icon and one frozen instant, consistent figure proportions and baseline; no multi-panel sheets, captions, headings or frames
design.color: single alpha-based artwork tinted from app's currentColor; no baked background/checkerboard, no permanent navy ink, no multicolor fill
design.vector: final SVG contains native paths/shapes only, no embedded PNG/JPEG/SVG as image data; if not fully vector, label accurately as tintable raster mask
design.assets: Never mutate original approved v4.6 donors; add reviewed corrected candidates to new paths only

hierarchy.smallRail: At 48/64 px show one action or one priest station; cropped gesture/silhouette or text may replace complex full-altars
hierarchy.expandedGuide: Full priest-plus-altar context only when source comprehension benefits, still as minimal pictogram
hierarchy.legibilityGate: A reviewer can identify the correct action at 64px without reading its label; where impossible use a source-backed text cue instead
hierarchy.actorGate: Reader's posture vs priest vs deacon vs thurifer never conflated

prohibitions: embroidered Roman chasubles and patterned lace
baroque altar architecture or carved panels
crosshatching, woodcut/engraving simulation, texture or shadows
scene borders, infographic layouts and grids
false altar positions or perspective mirroring
recoloring detailed artwork and calling it harmonized
promoting generated sheets or raster-wrapped SVG as production icons

acceptanceGates.name: RATING
acceptanceGates.rule: Reject originals rated 0–2. 3 researches, 4 reviews, 5 confirms; unrated pending.

acceptanceGates.name: REUSE
acceptanceGates.rule: Compare selected originals and matching physical actions before drawing.

acceptanceGates.name: RUBRICS
acceptanceGates.rule: Precise actor, position, hands/objects and form according to source cue.

acceptanceGates.name: SILHOUETTE
acceptanceGates.rule: Head/face flat; vestments/altar stripped to only vital geometry; no etched decoration.

acceptanceGates.name: MOBILE
acceptanceGates.rule: Gesture recognizable at 64px, acceptable silhouette at 48px; otherwise text/zoomed detail.

acceptanceGates.name: UI_COLOR
acceptanceGates.rule: True alpha + variable tint on dark/light backgrounds; final vector path certification.

acceptanceGates.name: SELECTION
acceptanceGates.rule: Only 5 automatically selects; 4 awaits review; 3 directs research. Keep legacy source selections separate from new ratings.
